name: Survivor Québec
description: For over 40 days days, 20 players isolated on an exotic island in the Philippines will face extreme mental and physical challenges. They will have to use strategy to survive the eliminations in order to become the sole survivor and get their hands on the $100,000 grand prize!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 20 players are divided into 2 tribes. After two challenges, the losing tribe is invited to the first Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After an initial elimination, the tribes face off in a challenge to determine who will win a reward.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Strategies are in full swing in both tribes, and the hunt is on for hidden immunity idols. Who will find the clue first?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The tribes face off in a very physical challenge to determine which team will win immunity at the next Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Morale is low among the losing tribe, who have to eliminate one of their players. Who will become the 2nd person to leave Survivor Québec?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A high-stakes challenge awaits players from both tribes. Who will have to leave tonight?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Kalooban tribe is more motivated than ever, and a competition ensues against Tiyaga for a delicious reward.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: One of the tribes feasts on its victory and the mail announces news to the tribes: two opposing players will be able to meet!

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: An emotional day for the competitors as they face off in a challenge to determine which tribe will win immunity.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The losing tribe will have to make a heartbreaking choice: who will leave tonight and, above all, which alliance will be broken?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Immunity is back up for grabs. A fifth player will be eliminated, but what will be their fate?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A tough morning the next day of the elimination for one of the tribes and a challenge for a reward that makes the players' mouths water.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A big surprise for the winning tribe of the last challenge: they get to visit the opposing team and steal supplies!

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: An impressive challenge awaits the tribes and morale is low at Tiyaga.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: During the Tribal Council, the players are shaken by a turn of events, and strategies are set in motion.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: An immunity challenge awaits the tribes, where mutual aid will take on a whole new meaning. Who will see their flame extinguished tonight?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A surprise awaits the tribes at the reward challenge. The time has come for a reshuffle. Which alliances will be overturned?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The reshuffle is difficult for some, and the delicious reward brings a big surprise for the winning tribe.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The tribes face off in a challenge under a blazing sun, and new alliances take shape among Tiyaga and Kalooban.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Will it be Kalooban or Tiyaga saying goodbye to one of its players tonight? Will the new alliances hold?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The latest Tribal Council confirms a new ally in Tiyaga's majority alliance. Who will have to leave Survivor Québec tonight?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After an unexpected elimination, Tiyaga plans the next big moves. Who will win the reward, Kalooban or Tiyaga?

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The tribes welcome a mysterious visitor into their midst, but is their presence harmless?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Who will win the reward challenge tonight, Tiyaga or Kalooban?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Tiyaga's allies will have to make choices - will they make the right decision for the tribe's future?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: The time has finally come for the merge. The first individual immunity is at stake during the challenge. Whose torch will be extinguished?

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Individual immunity is once again at stake at a surprising Tribal Council. Who will be the second player on Redemption Island?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Players officially choose the name of their new tribe and compete in a gruelling reward challenge.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Tonight, the winning team enjoys a culinary treat that's sure to make waves.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Many surprises await players at the Survivor Québec auction.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: A classic Survivor immunity challenge pushes players to the limit. Tonight, who will head for Redemption Island?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The players receive a touching surprise. On Redemption Island, the arrival of a 3rd person surprises Sylvain and Nicolas.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The three players on Redemption Island take part in their first face-off. Who will lose and become the 1st member of the jury?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Players tell each other their truth to earn a reward, and learn about the existence of Redemption Island.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Tonight, Pag-Asa players receive news from Redemption Island. How will this affect the remaining alliances?

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: A choice awaits the players at the immunity challenge. Tonight, a 13th person will be eliminated. Will they go the way of redemption?

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: A clarification on the distribution of votes is needed after the last council meeting. A 2nd face-off takes place in the Redemption Arena.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Tonight, the face-off on Redemption Island continues. Who will be eliminated and become the 2nd member of the jury?

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Which player will win the reward challenge, and above all, what heartbreaking choice will the winner be offered?

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: An amazing treasure hunt awaits Pag-Asa players. What is in the mysterious chest?

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Tonight's immunity challenge is one of endurance and balance. Who will join Nicolas and Sylvain on Redemption Island?

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Time for a reunion on Redemption Island. It is also time for the 3rd face-off in the arena!

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Who will be officially eliminated: Nicolas, Sylvain or Maryse?

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: The players receive a visit from their loved ones, one of the most touching episodes of the season.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: An important reward will have to be shared between the players. Who will be able to enjoy this precious moment?

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Strategies are becoming increasingly divergent in the main Pag-Asa alliance. Tonight, who will be the 15th person to be eliminated?

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: An update after the latest Tribal Council. This is the long-awaited moment: the final confrontation in the Arena of Redemption.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: The final confrontation on Redemption Island continues. Who will be back in the Pag-Asa tribe: Nicolas, Sylvain or Sandrine?

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: What is the famous reward promised by Patrice, and which player will win the challenge?

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Tonight, players will be treated to a memorable outing that is sure to take them back to childhood.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: All the players want to secure their place in the top 5 by winning the immunity challenge. Tonight, who will be eliminated?

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: In the wake of a surprising Tribal Council, the players face off in an immunity challenge. Who will secure a place in the top 4?

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: A heart-rending Tribal Council awaits the players. Who will make up the official top 4 of Survivor Québec?

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Tonight, the candidates face their final immunity challenge. Who will directly qualify for the final?

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: The last 4 players look back on the highlights of their journey, and the members of the jury give their verdict on the adventure.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Tonight, the time has come for the grand finale! Who will win the title of last survivor?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 20 players are divided into 2 tribes. After 2 challenges, including immunity, the losing tribe is invited to the first Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The losing tribe recovers from an eventful first council. A mythical Survivor challenge awaits the players. Which tribe will win?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A surprise expedition is in store for two players, and they have an important choice to make. Will they make the right decision?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The tribes face off in a heated battle to determine which team will win immunity at the next Tribal Council.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Morale is low among the losing tribe. Who will be eliminated and become the 3rd person to leave SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After a unanimous elimination, an aquatic immunity test awaits players from both tribes. Who will have to leave tonight?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Tempers flare as a misadventure catches a player off guard during the night. Who will win the endurance event for a reward?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A summit meeting awaits two players from each tribe. Who will be the players chosen to take part in this mysterious encounter?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The two tribes face off in a floating maze challenge. Which tribe will walk away with immunity and avoid the next Tribal Council?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The losing tribe must eliminate one of their own. An announcement from Patrice confuses the council. Who will be eliminated tonight?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: A surprise awaits the players. Immunity is back up for grabs. Tonight, who will be the next person to be eliminated from SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: An eventful return to camp following elimination. A classic challenge awaits the players from the tribes. Who will win the prize?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Time for a Mexican fiesta! Players from the winning tribe gather for a big feast of nachos and tacos.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The two tribes compete in an endurance challenge. Which team will win immunity and avoid a Tribal Council?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The players from the losing tribe join Patrice for a Tribal Council. Who will be the 6th person to be eliminated from SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After an unexpected Tribal Council, the players are once again faced with an immunity challenge.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Tonight, the Tribal Council continues. Who will get individual immunity and who will be eliminated tonight?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Two players duel under the hot Philippine sun. Who will win a visit from Patrice and an advantage?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The long-awaited tribal reshuffle! The players will have to choose who they want to play with next. Who will win the reward challenge?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The players get to know their new tribe following the reshuffle. A mystery chest is placed on the Exile. What's inside?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The players are once again faced with an immunity challenge. Who will be the 8th person to be eliminated from SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: An emotional return to camp for the tribe, which had to eliminate one of its players. Tonight, who will win the reward?

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: A reward awaits the winning tribe. Back at camp, a secret advantage is hidden. Will they be able to find it?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: One of SURVIVOR's toughest immunity challenges awaits the players. Who will be able to save their skin and avoid a Tribal Council?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Players from the losing tribe will go to the Tribal Council. Who will be the 9th person to be eliminated from SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: An immunity challenge awaits the two the tribes. Who will be the 10th person to be eliminated from SURVIVOR QUÉBEC?

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: A letter prompts the players to seek immunity on each of the islands. Who will win the reward tonight, Nawa or Bayani?

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Players from both tribes finally discover the existence of the Exile! How will the players react to the sight of their former teammates?

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The 4 exiled players battle it out to determine who will return to the game at the merge. Which one of them will win?

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After 23 days on the islands, the players talk about their game and the highlights of their journey so far.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: The time has finally come for the merge. The first individual immunity is at stake. Tonight, who will become the first member of the jury?

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Following Dalawa's first Tribal Council, alliances become entangled. Tonight, which player will win the reward challenge?

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Three players leave as a reward. Upon their return, the players receive a very special kind of mail: letters from their loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Players are separated into pairs for a mythical challenge that combines agility and mud! The winning duo will make an important decision.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: The two players in solitary confinement must solve a riddle in order to take part in the next round. Will they succeed in this mission?
